text.p: Reinsurance Australia Corp Ltd said on Monday the 1997 calendar year had commenced well despite continued softening in market conditions.
"The 1997 year has commenced well, despite the continued softening in the market, with gross written premiums written to date estimated at A$325 million," Reinsurance said.
Gross written premium in calendar 1996 was A$527.3 million.

Reinsurance said the diversity of the portfolio of businesses provides a platform for sustainable future growth, and puts the company in a strong position to avoid the pricing pressures present in some sectors of the market.
"The company's objective is to place itself firmly in the world's top 20 international reinsurers at the start of the next decade," it said.
Earlier the company reported a 31 percent rise in net profit to A$66.6 million for calendar 1996.
Reinsurance shares closed six cents higher at A$4.69 on Friday. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
